summary: Publish generated analysis coverage and media as CI artifacts

delivery.outcome: Scheduled and manually dispatched CI publishes analysis, coverage and hash-verified media artifacts without repository writes.
nonGoals: Create new release media without an approved source

architecture.decision: Use three isolated read-only CI jobs and SHA-pinned actions; recover the accepted media baseline from its registry-bound source commit.
architecture.rollback: Revert the protected merge to restore the previous weekly workflow.

validation.evidence: managed gates, YAML parse and protected checks
